bull.narrative: KLAC rides the trend of increasing complexity and miniaturization of semiconductor devices, with revenue growth exceeding 10% YoY and market cap reaching $1.5T by 2033.

base.narrative: KLAC maintains its position as a leader in semiconductor inspection and metrology equipment, with revenue growth at 5% YoY and market cap reaching $800B by 2033.

bear.narrative: KLAC faces increasing competition and declining demand for semiconductor devices, with revenue shrinking by 5% YoY and market cap falling to $200B by 2033.
